# HealthyPlate — Backlog

*Generated by Feature Gap Analysis. Compares `public/prototype.html` (design source-of-truth) against the current implementation.*

**Last updated:** 2026-04-27 (commit `4d25326`, pre-multi-child push)

**Legend:** ✅ Done · 🟡 Partial · ⏳ Stub (Coming-soon) · ❌ Missing · — N/A

---

## Changes since last audit

- **Multi-child support shipped (no auth)**: Home now has a child-switcher dropdown (`app/(app)/home/ChildSwitcher.tsx`) listing every child for the default user with an "Add another child" entry that routes to `/onboarding`. Active child stored in an `hp_active_child` cookie; `getCurrentChildId()` in `lib/getCurrentChild.ts` now resolves cookie → fallback-to-latest. New child created in step 1 of onboarding writes the cookie automatically. All inline `db.child.findFirst({orderBy: {createdAt: "desc"}})` lookups across snap / taste / onboarding refactored to use the centralized helper, so every screen honors the active child.
- **Taste catalog expanded from 10 → 300 foods** across 8 categories (Vegetables / Fruits / Proteins / Grains / Dairy / Snacks / Spices / Drinks). Original 10 slugs preserved at the top of `mockData.FOODS` so existing `TasteRating` rows stay valid. Seed batched in groups of 25 to avoid saturating the Postgres connection pool on cold-boot.
- **Onboarding step 3 (habits) gained a free-text food-preferences questionnaire** — three textareas: ❤️ likes / 🚫 dislikes / 🤔 maybes. Stored as nullable `Child.foodLikes` / `foodDislikes` / `foodMaybes` columns (migration `20260426120000_add_food_preferences`).
- **Auto-mapping from free-text prefs to taste-test ratings** (`lib/matchFoodPrefs.ts`). Word-boundary regex match with simple plural/singular variants; matched foods get `love` / `hard-no` / `maybe` ratings inserted via `createMany({ skipDuplicates: true })` so existing manual ratings are never overwritten.
- **"+30 unlocks her starter plan" copy variant** on the taste-test progress strip; threshold lifted from 6 → 30 with `STARTER_PLAN_THRESHOLD` constant; progress bar fills toward the 30-rating threshold (not the full 300) so the milestone feels achievable.
- **Build step now auto-applies Prisma migrations** (`prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate && next build`). Production schema changes ship with the deploy that introduces them — no manual migration step.
- **iOS gallery upload fixed** by splitting the file input into two — one with `capture="environment"` for the shutter (camera-only), one without for the library button (gallery picker).
- **Phone-photo size cap fixed**: client-side JPEG resize to 1600px / quality 0.82 before upload (`compressForVision` in `app/snap/page.tsx`) — keeps base64 well under Anthropic's 5MB vision-API limit.

## Suggested next-sprint priorities

The snap loop is real end-to-end, the 300-food taste catalog is in, and onboarding now feeds the taste graph automatically through the new free-text questionnaire. Top priorities flip toward closing visible gaps on Home + Insights:

### 1. Wire taste-graph data into the Home + Insights surfaces *(small win, big visible impact)*
- **Home — Profile-completion ring**: `db.tasteRating.count` for the current child → render the ring + copy. With the new onboarding auto-fills, most children will land on Home with a non-zero rated count already.
- **Insights — Taste graph bars**: aggregate ratings → render the prototype's veggie bars.
- All the data is already there; this is a render-only sprint.

### 2. Fix private-blob photo display (or switch the store to public)
- Confirm page and Meal Analysis currently render `<img src={privateBlobUrl}>` which won't load for browser fetches.
- Cheapest fix: switch the Vercel Blob store to public access (config flip in dashboard) — then `put({access: "public"})` works again, URLs are reachable, no app-code change needed.
- Robust fix: add an authenticated proxy route (e.g. `/api/snap-photo/[id]`) that streams the blob bytes server-side using the R/W token.

### 3. Onboarding step 1 — H/W + skip-later flow
- Schema: `heightCm`, `weightKg`, `lastMeasuredAt` on `Child` (nullable, with migration).
- Restore the prototype's skip-later UI.
- Surface "Time to measure" CTA on Home (gated on `lastMeasuredAt` > 30 days ago).

### 4. Smarter free-text matching for onboarding step 3
- Current matcher misses synonyms ("berries" → strawberry/blueberry/raspberry) and group phrases ("anything green" → all green vegetables, "no fish" → all seafood).
- Promote `matchFoodPrefs` to an Anthropic LLM extraction call: send the three text blocks + a category-grouped catalog, parse a structured response of {foodId, rating} pairs.
- Optional: keep the regex matcher as a fallback so the taste test still pre-fills if the LLM call fails.

### 5. After-shot real `percentEaten` (a real second vision pass)
- Currently `saveAfterSnap` copies before-foods with `percentEaten: 50` placeholder.
- Run a second Anthropic vision call comparing before vs after photos to estimate per-food consumption.

### 6. USDA nutrient data
- Replace `lib/nutrition.ts` illustrative numbers with USDA FoodData Central data for the 300-food catalog.
- Either fetch via the FDC API (requires a free API key) or bundle a curated JSON.
- Unblocks accurate Meal Analysis nutrient breakdowns.

### 7. Plan + Insights MVPs
- Use the (now meaningful) taste graph + meal history to drive a real weekly plan and a real balance history.

## Status legend

- **Status**: ✅ `Built` (live in app), 🟡 `Partial` (live but incomplete), ⏳ `Stub` (Coming-soon placeholder), ❌ `Missing` (not implemented)
- **Design Fidelity**: ✅ `Done` only if it matches the prototype's design tokens *and* screen-level layout. 🟡 `Partial` if any prototype components are missing.
- **Database Connection**: ✅ `Done` only if there is an active Prisma call hitting Postgres in the live code path. Mock data and localStorage do not count.
